title: Shredded Chicken
description: Instant Pot shredded chicken seasoned with chili powder, cumin, and garlic, pressure-cooked in salsa and broth, then finished uncovered to absorb the liquid. Works great with salsa verde.

vegetarian.notes: Chicken is structural to this recipe. No vegetarian adaptation is possible.

steps.title: Season and add liquids
steps.text: Add {i04}, {i05}, {i06}, {i07}, and {i08} to the chicken. Pour {i03} over the top to cover, then pour in {i02}.

steps.text: Seal the Instant Pot and cook on high pressure for 12 minutes.

steps.text: Return shredded {i01} to the Instant Pot. Add {i09} and {i10}. Cook uncovered on high (sauté mode) for 5 minutes, or until the broth is mostly absorbed.

rawText:
Shredded Chicken

	⁃	1 cup chicken broth 
	⁃	1 cup salsa (any kind, but verde rules)

	⁃	1 tsp chili powder
	⁃	1 tsp garlic powder 
	⁃	1 tsp cumin
	⁃	1 tsp salt
	⁃	1 tsp black pepper 

Sear in instant pot 
Add seasoning
Cover in salsa
Pour in broth 
12 min on high
Shred in KitchenAid
Put back in pot, add a handful of cilantro and some lime, and cook uncovered on high for 5 min, or until broth is mostly absorbed
